title: "Exception while calling service of node ... : None" in ros2 param list: nodes that don't spin, blocked callbacks, unspun second nodes, RMW mismatches and Jazzy's silent hang, measured
excerpt: ros2 param list printed "Exception while calling service of node ...: None" on Humble, hung silently on Jazzy and timed out after 5 s on Lyrical. Four causes reproduced in Docker, each with the fix and the time it took to answer afterwards.
